concept.title: Internet Service Provider (ISP)
concept.shortdesc: An Internet Service Provider (ISP) supplies Internet connectivity to a home network. The ISP enables users to access websites, online-services, and Internet-based applications.

section.title: Overview
section.p: An Internet Service Provider (ISP) is a company that provides Internet access to homes and businesses.
The ISP acts as the connection between a local network and the Internet.
Without an ISP, devices on a home network can communicate with each other locally, but they cannot access Internet resources.

section.title: Role of the ISP
section.p: The ISP delivers Internet services to the customer's location.
The ISP provides internet connection through a modem, cable modem, Fiber modem, or optical network terminal (ONT).

section.title: Why an ISP is Important
section.p: The ISP makes Internet communication possible by providing a path between the home network and external networks.
Every device that accesses websites, cloud services, online applications, or streaming platforms uses the Internet connection supplied by the ISP.
